_comment: FROZEN reset target — the FULL shipped component definition per composite (not just knobs), so removing a shipped component is recoverable in-app: Reset restores it exactly, formula/bounds/label included. Every field MUST stay byte-identical to config/risk-model.json's components (scripts/fingerprint_check.ts asserts it field by field). lookupTables carries the default+rows only (Stage B).

performanceComposite.label: Quality
performanceComposite.definition: Existing quality sub-score: per-PO defect rate + complaint rate, each normalized 0-100 against fixed bounds, averaged. Computed by scores.py from transaction data; a built-in sub-score, not a formula-editable component.

performanceComposite.label: Delivery
performanceComposite.definition: Existing delivery sub-score: on-time-delivery % + average lead time, each normalized 0-100 against fixed bounds, averaged. Computed by scores.py from transaction data; a built-in sub-score, not a formula-editable component.

performanceComposite.label: Process
performanceComposite.definition: Existing process sub-score: three-way-match pass rate, normalized 0-100. Computed by scores.py from transaction data; a built-in sub-score, not a formula-editable component.

performanceComposite.label: Risk
performanceComposite.definition: The performanceRisk composite output (structural: country distance + roster concentration, inverted so higher=safer). A built-in sub-score, not a formula-editable component.

performanceRisk.label: Country distance
performanceRisk.definition: Geographic supply-distance tier of the supplier's country. 0-100 lookup {Indonesia:0, ASEAN:30, Asia-Pacific:60, other:100}.

performanceRisk.label: Roster concentration
performanceRisk.definition: Roster-based supply concentration (the SAME curve as supplyRisk.supply_concentration), on the 0-100 axis {0:100,1:70,2:44,3:24,4:10,>=5:0}.

supplyRisk.label: Supply concentration
supplyRisk.definition: Step curve on the number of OTHER suppliers in the same category across the full roster (active or not); fewer alternatives -> higher risk. Normalized curve {0:100,1:70,2:44,3:24,4:10,>=5:0}.

supplyRisk.label: Cost premium
supplyRisk.definition: Spend-weighted item-price premium vs the cross-supplier benchmark, over supplier x item pairs with >=2 POs where the item has >=2 suppliers. Normalized clip(premium*250, 0, 100); at/below market -> 0.

supplyRisk.label: Import friction
supplyRisk.definition: Indonesia trade-agreement coverage of the supplier's country. Normalized {domestic:0, AFTA:32, RCEP-non-ASEAN:64, other:100}.
